MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

   D. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
